text:
Marta (Finance): FYI invoice 93124 just failed — card declined, issuer returned 'issuer_hold' citing cross-border currency mismatch. Customer offered to split: card for partial, wire for remainder. Need EU wire instructions + any tax docs we require. CC @Sam (Sales)
Sam (Sales): They're an EU buyer. Attempted card charge was in EUR but card issuer blocked. Customer can do €8,000 by card now, remaining €12,000 via wire. Can we produce EUR wire details and confirm which tax/identity docs they must attach? They want ETA today.
Rey (Support): I pulled the auth logs — two attempts, codes: 402_card_decline / auth_reason: issuer_restricted. Network suggests not to auto-retry without customer consent.
ops-banking-bot: New wire request created: WR-4521 (automated).
Theo (CS): I'll confirm timing with the customer and request VAT ID + signed wire consent. They also asked for beneficiary name and remittance instructions.
Marta (Finance): For EU wires we should use our EU payout entity. Also check if we need customer VAT ID for VAT-breakdown invoice. For US customers doing cross-border, tax forms vary; for EU B2B we just need VAT ID.
ops-banking: Bank provided the EU details, sharing snippet to paste to customer:

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference B.V.
IBAN: NL91ABNA0417164300
BIC: ABNANL2A
Reference: INV-93124 / PO 778
Currency: EUR
```

Sam (Sales): Perfect. Theo — ask them to include INV-93124 + company name in remittance. Also collect their VAT ID and any bank transfer confirmation once sent.
Theo (CS): Reaching out now, will request VAT ID and a screenshot of wire confirmation when they initiate.
Marta (Finance): Also — invoice had an automatic card-retry scheduled for tomorrow. Please disable auto-retry since customer will wire the balance, and we don't want duplicate attempts. @ops-billing can you cancel scheduled retries for INV-93124?
ops-billing: Auto-retry cancelled for INV-93124. Billing ticket BR-778 updated with WR-4521 link.
Rey (Support): Note for reconciliation: record partial card settlement if it posts. If wire posts first, reconcile against open balance and mark invoice fully paid after final application.
Sam (Sales): Customer asked if we can issue a receipt for the partial card payment once it posts — yes?
Marta (Finance): Yes — issue a pro-rata receipt when the card posts, then final receipt after wire reconciliation. I'll add a note on the invoice: "split payment — card then wire; await customer VAT ID; auto-retry disabled."
Sam (Sales): Great, will confirm timing with them. :thumbsup:
Theo (CS): Customer replied — wiring today late afternoon and will upload confirmation. Sending VAT ID now.
Marta (Finance): Thanks — keep this thread updated when the confirmation and funds arrive. Closing internal prep once cash application is done.
